Welcome to unloadedforce.com! 

If selected

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals or companies who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an Affiliate/Influencer (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

The commission rate is 20% and will be determined by Unloaded Force. We look forward to answering any questions. unloadedforce@mail.com

By participating in the Program, the affiliate/influencer agrees to use the program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms/Conditions and Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these Terms/Conditions and Privacy Policy in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate/Influencer or participate in the Program in any manner. Unloaded Force is DBA as Untamed Force Inc and oned and operated by Untamed Force Inc.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate or Influencer Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate/Influencer Program Registration. Must be over 18 years of age to apply.


2. Affiliate/Influencers Links and Coupon

Affiliate/Influencer link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate/Influencers might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate/Influencers may also advertise on websites, Facebook, Instagram and other social media platforms,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers. No adult, illegal or criminal websites or social media pages are permitted.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and does not include extra fees, tax, bank/Paypal fees and shipping cost.

For an Affiliate or Influencer to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate/Influencer guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate/Influencer Program is subject to a fair use policy that gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed is in the commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out. Affiliate/Influencer performance will be reviewed quarterly if an Affiliate/Influencer is decreasing in sales or has no activity we reserve the right to decrease commission percentage with notice. Agreed commission payments will be sent to the affiliate or Influencer after 30 days of the customers' purchase. No commission will be granted if the customer returns the product or products before the 30 day return period then your commission will not be applied. **You must have your custom Unloaded Force URL link in your social media bio and in your posts or your website related to Unloaded Force products. You must use Unloaded Force products in your Unloaded Force posts and not mix-match with other brands. Unloaded Force apparel mixed with blank apparel is also accepted** All Affiliate or Influencer commission and agreements must be kept confidential. The commission will only be granted while the Affiliate or Influencer is registered and listed in the Affiliate or Influencer Unloaded Force program.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on Affiliate/Influencers channels.


5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, The Affiliate/Influencer can invite others to become their downline Affiliate. If any downline Affiliates brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other Affiliates/Influencers into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the Affiliate’s/Influencers link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant's website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate/Influencer link then).


7. Removal from Referral  Program

If an Affiliate or Influencer wishes to be removed from the affiliate influencer program, they can do so by contacting: unloadedforce@mail.com If an Affiliate or Influencer is involved in a scandal, bad press or criminal activity Unloaded Force reserves the right to immediately cancel any ties and  Affiliate or Influencer program on the Affiliate or Influencer. Deals or contracts between the Affiliate or Influencer and Unloaded Force. Unloaded Force also reveres to right to cancel any ties, deals or contracts between the affiliate or influencer and Unloaded Force at any time without reason.  


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send an email for support unloadedforce@mail.com
